column1: --11. Is there any correlation between number of wins and team salary?
Use data from 2000 and later to answer this question.
keep in mind that salaries across the whole league tend to increase together
so you may want to look on a year-by-year basis
RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY teams.yearid ORDER BY teams.w DESC) AS win_rank
RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY teams.yearid ORDER BY SUM(salaries.salary) DESC) AS salary_rank
